title: Spatial Attention Supervision for Defect Localization: Exploiting Ground-Truth Masks as Training Signal in Diffusion-Augmented Defect Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.06232v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ground-truth defect masks in industrial inspection datasets are typically reserved for evaluation. This paper repurposes them as spatial supervision signals during training of classification networks, teaching a model not just what to predict but where to look. The method adds an activation-based attention alignment loss that steers convolutional feature maps toward defect regions, in a mixed-supervision formulation that also accommodates samples without masks, such as diffusion-generated images. Combined with DDPM augmentation, synthetic images contribute quantity while masks contribute spatial precision. We evaluate 85 models (four CNN backbones under a 2x2 data/training factorial over five seeds, plus a Swin-V2-T transformer baseline) on the MVTec-AD bottle benchmark, with localization measured on held-out defect images excluded from classifier gradient updates. translated_title: 面向缺陷定位的空间注意力监督：在扩散增强缺陷检测中将真实掩码用作训练信号
translated_abstract: 工业检测数据集中的真实缺陷掩码通常仅用于评估。本文将这些掩码重新用作分类网络训练过程中的空间监督信号，不仅教会模型预测什么，还教会模型应该关注哪里。该方法添加了一个基于激活的注意力对齐损失，引导卷积特征图聚焦于缺陷区域，并采用混合监督的公式化设计，同时兼容没有掩码的样本，例如扩散生成的图像。结合DDPM数据增强，合成图像贡献了数据数量，而掩码贡献了空间精度。我们在MVTec-AD瓶子基准上评估了85个模型（四个CNN骨干网络在2×2数据/训练因子设计下、五个随机种子，以及一个Swin-V2-T Transformer基线），定位性能在从分类器梯度更新中排除的保留缺陷图像上进行测量。主要发现：（1）注意力引导的训练改善了基于激活的…
tldr: 该论文的核心创新是将真实缺陷掩码从传统的仅用于评估转变为分类网络训练的空间监督信号，通过基于激活的注意力对齐损失引导卷积特征图聚焦缺陷区域，并在混合监督框架下结合DDPM扩散增强实现合成图像提供数据量、掩码提供空间精度的互补优势，从而提升缺陷定位能力。
en_tdlr: This paper repurposes ground-truth defect masks as spatial supervision signals during classifier training via an activation-based attention alignment loss, and in a mixed-supervision framework combined with DDPM augmentation, lets synthetic images contribute quantity while masks provide spatial precision for improved defect localization.
